g.text: This application simulates F1 race outcomes based on driver skills, car performance,
track characteristics, and variable weather conditions.
All data is fictional and represents a hypothetical 2026 F1 season.
Available races in the 2026 F1 Calendar:
| 5 | Jeddah Corniche Circuit | Saudi Arabia | April 17-19, 2026 |
| 18 | Marina Bay Street Circuit | Singapore | October 9-11, 2026 |
| 19 | Circuit of the Americas | USA | October 23-25, 2026 |
| 21 | Autódromo José Carlos Pace | Brazil | November 6-8, 2026 |
| 22 | Las Vegas Strip Circuit | USA | November 19-21, 2026 |
